profile.headline: Senior Engineer at Universal Avionics Systems Corporation
profile.summary: Versatile systems engineer with five years of experience, primarily designing and developing software applicatons within an agile environment. Possess strong programming and analytical skills with the ability to determine impacts and produce a solution in an efficient manner. Active DoD SECRET CLEARANCE

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Simulation and Systems Integration Lead 

- Collaborates with team members as well as multiple software teams on highly visible requirements and design documentation which has resulted in on time submission of deliverables.
- Responsible for developing simulation system Graphical User Interfaces (GUI’s) for future class of submarines using the QT development tool.
- Responsible for developing equations to simulate the effects of buoyancy of the submarine during hardware-in-the-loop missions.
- Responsible for developing code using specific algorithms to test the state of the submarines during specific missions.
- Responsible for developing API drivers utilizing VxWorks real-time operating systems (RTOS).
- Conducts research/trade studies and presents this information either through PowerPoint presentations or through proof of concept demonstrations to the customer.

positions.title: Engineer II
positions.description:
Developed Graphical User Interfaces (GUI’s) that simulated boat functions to support testing.  Promoted to Test Team Lead primarily responsible for updating test procedures to accommodate hardware and software upgrades.   Updated code by adding functionality that supported testing of various scenarios for future nuclear powered ships that will be developed. 
Ran model simulations to determine the impact on ship control due to submarine operations.  The results of these simulations helped define product requirements.
Conducted trade studies/white papers, and participated in proof of concept presentations to the client from the model simulation data that assessed impacts to ship design in order to save on construction cost. 
Collaborated with multiple teams to assess risk of impact on one subsystem to another. 
Updated test procedures to accommodate hardware and software upgrades.

positions.title: Engineer I
positions.description:
Supported the software team by performing unit test in a Unix/Linux environment. 
Provided technical support for Virginia Class nuclear powered ships through operability test, updated technical documents for various software builds being installed onto the ships. Worked with the crew on the boats to troubleshoot various issues.
